fact: The 2023 national statistical yearbook, published January 2025, covers 2019 to 2023 and draws on administrative data from sector services (66 of 67 structures responded), with chapters on social security, security, education, health, justice, taxes and transport.
title: Annuaire statistique national 2023
publisher: Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques et démographiques (INSEED)
